message: The aspect '{0}' cannot introduce the indexer '{1}' into the type '{2}' because the indexer is static. C# does not support static indexers.
rationale: In 'because it is static', the pronoun can refer to the type '{2}', which is misleading because a static target type is a different problem (LAMA0505, CannotIntroduceInstanceMember); the report site in IntroduceIndexerAdvice.ValidateBuilder checks IsStatic on the indexer builder. The message also lacks the articles before 'indexer' and 'type'.
